svg.title: Per-build state and ClangTidyContext
svg.desc: Stack-local tidy state in ParsedAST::build becomes the state of one TidyASTListener per main-file build. Context, checks and finder retain their roles; member order ensures the context outlives the checks and finder. The options are moved into the context. Preamble listeners remain inactive.
svg.text: Stack-local tidy state in ParsedAST::build becomes the state of one TidyASTListener per main-file build.
// The lifetime of DiagnosticOptions is managed by \c Clang.
// The lifetime of DiagnosticOptions is managed by \c Clang.
// Destruction order matters: Finder and checks refer to Context.
Context, checks and finder retain their roles; member order ensures the context outlives the checks and finder.
The options are moved into the context. Preamble listeners remain inactive.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
